title: JANUS Linear A SigLA source-adapter contract derivation specification

contract_invariants.common_script_src: exact set intersection of all non-empty script src values across the three word-view snapshots
contract_invariants.common_stylesheet_href: exact set intersection of all non-empty stylesheet href values across the three word-view snapshots
contract_invariants.common_tag_names: exact set intersection of tag names observed at least once on each word-view snapshot
contract_invariants.common_class_names: exact set intersection of class names observed at least once on each word-view snapshot
contract_invariants.common_nonempty_anchor_texts: exact set intersection of normalized non-empty anchor texts across the three word-view snapshots

candidate_contract_fail_closed_requireme: word-view route must remain exactly index-word.html relative to frozen document root
HTTP retrieval must succeed before content parsing
all invariants admitted from the three-way intersection must be present
source-native text order must be preserved
absence of required invariant means adapter-contract failure rather than fallback guessing
forbidden: do not access mwenge transcription content
do not select additional or replacement documents
do not infer sign or word semantics
do not generalize from a feature observed on fewer than all three frozen pages
do not use frequency thresholds to rescue non-common classes/tags
do not call the derived candidate a scientific replication result
success_gate: Exact artifact metadata validates, embedded probe result validates, all three snapshots reparse identically to recorded observables, and a deterministic three-way intersection contract candidate is emitted with scientific claim ceiling false.
next_if_successful: Inspect the committed candidate and freeze only its mechanically derived invariants as SigLA source-adapter contract v0.1 before any content-audit specification.
